dict.string: OpenDesk uses AppleScript to query the accessibility tree of focused applications so Claude can click, type, and read native UI elements precisely. No data leaves your machine without your action.
OpenDesk needs the Accessibility permission to control the mouse and keyboard and to read the focused app's UI tree. Without this, Claude cannot operate your computer.
OpenDesk captures screenshots so Claude can see what is on your screen and annotate interactive elements with numbered marks.
OpenDesk does not use the camera.
OpenDesk does not use the microphone.
OpenDesk discovers and pairs with other OpenDesk machines on your LAN via mDNS so you can control them remotely with end-to-end encryption.
